title: Main Character Work
creator: FOCUS & CO
caption: Instrumental melodic deep house, no vocals. Felt piano melody, slow analog pads, plucked synth arpeggio, deep warm sub bass, soft claps, rolling percussion. Nocturnal, cinematic, focused, wide reverb. Evolving arrangement: filtered intro, chords and lead enter gradually, a breakdown without kick, then a fuller groove; the melody develops instead of looping. Hi-fi studio mix, warm and clean. Instrumental only.

title: Deep Weekday
creator: FOCUS & CO
caption: Instrumental lounge deep house, no vocals. Warm Rhodes minor ninth chords, soft grand piano melody, round low-passed bass, steady kick, swung brushed hi-hats, light shaker, a distant muted jazz trumpet adds a few soft phrases. Elegant late-night cocktail bar. Evolving arrangement: filtered intro, chords and lead enter gradually, a breakdown without kick, then a fuller groove; the melody develops instead of looping. Hi-fi studio mix, warm and clean. Instrumental only.

title: Black Coffee
creator: FOCUS & CO
caption: Instrumental deep tech house, minimal, no vocals. Rolling dubby bassline, tight kick, crisp shuffled hats, shakers and woodblock, short Rhodes chord stabs with tape delay, soft filtered pads, subtle percussion fills. Calm, focused, hypnotic, deep work. Evolving arrangement: filtered intro, chords and lead enter gradually, a breakdown without kick, then a fuller groove; the melody develops instead of looping. Hi-fi studio mix, warm and clean. Instrumental only.
